settings.name: provider
settings.description: model provider the native harness uses

settings.name: harness.max_steps
settings.description: maximum tool/model steps a harness run may take

settings.name: harness.step_timeout
settings.description: seconds one command or provider step may run before the harness stops it

settings.name: harness.output_limit
settings.description: characters of command output kept in the prompt and transcript

settings.name: harness.max_cost
settings.description: provider units one harness run may spend before the harness stops it; 0 means no cap

settings.name: harness.keep_observations
settings.description: recent command observations kept in the model prompt when older output is summarized

settings.name: harness.context_window
settings.description: tokens of context the native harness assumes the model takes: past 80% of it older observations collapse harder; 0 reads the window from the provider's model list (1M for the Claude and Gemini models that take it, Copilot's per-model limit), and a model that lists none keeps context discipline at its first level

settings.name: harness.system_prompt
settings.description: custom harness system prompt template; empty uses the built-in default

settings.name: harness.instructions
settings.description: on: a native-harness run reads the clone's repository instruction files - AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md - into its system prompt; off: the task alone speaks for the repository

settings.name: harness.mcp_tools
settings.description: on: a native-harness run with a store connects the project's enabled MCP servers at its start and offers their tools to the model as mcp__<server>__<tool>; off: workers call servers through pulse mcp call only

settings.name: harness.skills
settings.description: on: a native-harness run offers the skill tool, which loads one skill's SKILL.md when the model asks; off: skills reach the model through the brief alone

settings.name: harness.hooks
settings.description: on: a native-harness run runs the owner's hooks from the clone's .pulse/hooks.json and ~/.pulse/hooks.json; off: no hooks run

settings.name: harness.memory
settings.description: on: a native-harness run reads ~/.pulse/memory into its system prompt and offers the memory tool; off: nothing is read or offered

settings.name: harness.web_search
settings.description: chat: pulse harness chat offers the web_search tool and jobs do not; on: jobs too; off: nowhere

settings.name: harness.subagents
settings.description: on: a native-harness run offers the subagent tool: a bounded helper run on a self-contained sub-task; off: the tool is not offered

settings.name: harness.fetch_allow
settings.description: hosts a native-harness run's fetch tool may read web pages from; empty turns the tool off

settings.name: harness.deny_tools
settings.description: permission rules every native-harness run refuses outright (tool or tool(filter), comma- or newline-separated); a tool denied whole is not offered

settings.name: harness.allow_tools
settings.description: permission rules pulse harness chat runs without asking (tool or tool(filter), comma- or newline-separated); deny rules win

settings.name: harness.compact_at
settings.description: percent of the context window at which a native-harness run summarises the older part of the conversation; 0 turns compaction off

settings.name: harness.reasoning
settings.description: the reasoning effort a native-harness run asks of the model, sent as reasoning_effort to the OpenAI-compatible providers and to copilot for the models that take it; default sends nothing

settings.name: worker_model
settings.description: model used for implementation runs

settings.name: light_model
settings.description: model used for lead, reflect and other light runs; empty means worker_model
